title: THE MEDAL ROW STANDS IN ITS SPOT
why: His answer of 2026-10-14: Halo puts medals in a row at the left, and the layout table reserves the spot. The new medal row of the party polish looked for a clear stretch of the left edge among the panels. It now stands in the reserved medal spot between the feed and the vitals (the emblems and the name plate under them fit it), so the feed, the controls list and the pillagers board can never be under it. The spot is 88 units tall, enough for both.
now: The medal row now stands in the reserved spot between the feed and the vitals.
